pages.title: Malagasy Dwarf Hippopotamus
pages.text: The Malagasy dwarf hippopotamus ($(o)Hippopotamus lemerlei$()) lived in the rivers and lakes of western Madagascar until about 1,000 years ago.$(br2)It looked like a small common hippo, about 2 metres long and 70 centimetres tall, with its eyes set high on its head for watching from the water.$(br2)Its ancestors were full-sized hippos that reached the island and shrank. Bones with butchery marks show that people hunted Malagasy hippos.
